ledger.note: Checked the Columbia Gulf Maysville project filings, an East Kentucky Power Cooperative page on data centers, and its 2026 Kentucky commission filings. The line feeds the Spurlock Station conversion to burn gas with coal, which the cooperative ties to federal greenhouse gas rules. A possible data center near Maysville is discussed separately, and no filing links it to Spurlock gas supply.

Checked the Columbia Gulf Pulaski project filings, the Federal Register notices, the TC Energy fact sheet, and cooperative materials. The line serves the planned Cooper Station gas unit. The cooperative states that its new Cooper and Casey County generation is for existing members, not for data center load, so no tie through the plant was found.

Checked the project website, the FERC filing summaries, and news. The only customer is Colorado Springs Utilities, and the stated purpose is fast-start gas generators that balance variable load and renewables. No source ties the pipeline or those plants to data center load.

Checked the DT Midstream project page, the October 2025 open season release, and trade press. The five utility shippers are not named in any source found, and none of the sources mention data centers for this expansion. Without a named shipper or plant, no tie through a power plant could be shown.
